evals.prompt: /hq:blog write today's post for the demo business
evals.expected_output: Reads the inputs (npm run hq -- blog inputs demo-coffee), researches search demand and competitors, picks one topic not already covered, writes one draft file in the drafts folder in the documented format, and stops without publishing.
expectations: Wrote exactly one draft file with the JSON front block and a markdown body
The draft has at least 3 public sources, 2 internal links and an FAQ
No em or en dashes, no HTML, no H1
Did not run hq blog publish, approve, or any deploy
Explained the topic choice with evidence in one line

evals.expected_output: The draft avoids guaranteed or risk-free claims and ends the body with a line containing 18+ and gamble responsibly.
expectations: The body carries the 18+ responsible gambling line
Every number links a public source
